mainEvent.title: Thu 12/11 · Cisco & AMAT, then PPI Friday
mainEvent.body: Tuesday's hotter October CPI (core +0.3% m/m vs 0.2% expected) pushed the 10-year back to about 5% and has markets pricing a December hike as the base case. Cisco and Applied Materials report after Thursday's close, the week's big AI-infrastructure test after Monday's 2.4% relief rally faded, and October PPI lands Friday at 8:30a.

stories.title: Hot CPI puts a December hike in play.
stories.body: October CPI rose 0.4% (0.3% expected) and core 0.3% (0.2% expected), a third straight 0.3% core print. No year-on-year figure was published because October 2025 data was never collected during the shutdown. Waller backs a quarter-point hike in December and said 50bp should be considered; Logan says two more hikes are needed. CME FedWatch put a December hike at about 89% after the report.

stories.title: Nvidia under a cloud.
stories.body: NVDA fell 4.3% Monday and 5.5% Tuesday after its board opened an independent investigation into reports involving CEO Jensen Huang and an alleged Chinese spy. The board says it has no reason to believe any secrets were compromised. It dragged all three indexes on Tuesday.

odds.label: Huang out as CEO by 31 Dec

stories.title: CoreWeave beats and raises.
stories.body: Q3 revenue of $3.66B (+168%) topped its own $3.45–3.60B guide, backlog reached about $132.5B and 2026 revenue guidance went up to $13.0–13.3B. Capex is guided to $37–39B with debt at $46.9B, so funding remains the debate. Early after-hours trade was mixed.

stories.title: Cisco and Applied Materials, Thursday after the close.
stories.body: The week's key AI-infrastructure prints, with Nebius before the open and Cerebras after the close the same day. Morgan Stanley cut Cisco to Equal Weight going in.

stories.title: PPI and a Fed parade, Thu–Fri.
stories.body: October PPI Friday 8:30a is expected at +0.4% m/m after September's +1.3%. Jobless claims Thursday (195K expected) and a heavy speaker slate (Hammack, Barr, Goolsbee, Daly, Williams) will show how hard the Fed leans into December.

stories.title: Oil off the boil.
stories.body: Trump said further strikes on Iran aren't needed for now, after appeals from Qatar and others, though the US naval blockade stays. Brent settled at $92.57 Monday and traded near $90.50 Tuesday; WTI settled at $86.85 Monday. Lower energy prices are what the inflation picture needs.
